config.label: Access token for inite
config.description: Access token for inite.solutions. Optional: the interview sheet and the arithmetic on what it collects run locally without one. Run `npx @inite/diagnostic login` to add the audit itself.

config.label: Bearer <access_token>
config.description: Bearer <access_token>. Clients that speak the MCP authorization flow obtain one on their own: an unauthenticated call returns 401 with WWW-Authenticate pointing at https://inite.solutions/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, which names auth.inite.ai as the authorization server.
